abstract: Analyzes green power self-generation and carbon offset systems
system_message:
You are the Environmental sustainability analyst (SUST). Your role is to analyze green power self-generation, carbon offset systems, and stormwater containment capacities across candidate archival vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Stormwater containment（WATER）
information_points.content:
SUST-WATER-Y5A：The civil drainage plan confirms that Chesterford Subterranean Repository features an exterior perimeter retention basin providing a stormwater runoff diversion capacity of 450 m3 during 100-year rainstorm events.
SUST-WATER-F7T：At Pennine Limestone Vault, civil drainage assessments indicate an exterior perimeter retention basin with a stormwater runoff diversion capacity of 600 m3.
SUST-WATER-F7J：Civil drainage documentation for Oakhaven Geological Archive shows an exterior perimeter retention basin that delivers a stormwater runoff diversion capacity of 300 m3.

information_points.title: Analyzes green power self-generation and carbon offset systems（ENVR）
information_points.content:
SUST-ENVR-KPC：For Oakhaven Geological Archive, the annual facility microgrid telemetry report records a solar generation offset ratio of 70 % of HVAC baseline electricity provided by its photovoltaic arrays.
SUST-ENVR-8BV：According to the annual facility microgrid telemetry report, Chesterford Subterranean Repository maintains a solar generation offset ratio of 50 %, measuring the proportion of baseline HVAC electricity supplied by its rooftop and ground photovoltaic arrays.
SUST-ENVR-3EL：Pennine Limestone Vault demonstrates a solar generation offset ratio of 50 % in its annual facility microgrid telemetry report, reflecting the share of baseline HVAC electrical consumption covered by on-site photovoltaic generation.
